legend.migration.title: Inter-county migration flows ({year}, household registration)
legend.migration.defaultRow: Top {k} flows nationwide + each county's largest outflow
legend.migration.clickHint: Click a county (base fill or white dot) to see its top {n} inflows and outflows
legend.migration.focusTotals: Year total: in {inflow}, out {outflow}, net {net} people
legend.migration.focusClear: Click the same county again or press Esc to return to the national view
legend.migration.hidden: {shown} flows drawn; {hidden} smaller flows not drawn (flows under {min} people are never drawn)
legend.migration.direction: Arcs bend from the origin county towards the destination; A→B and B→A curve to opposite sides
legend.migration.scope: Counts only moves of household registration between counties, excluding moves to or from abroad, first registrations and moves within a county; registration is not the same as an actual move. Differs from the 'Population migration (county)' statistics
legend.migration.base: Turn on the 'Net inter-county migration' statistics as a base (same data, summed); its year follows this layer
